title.en: Constrained optimisation, Lagrange multipliers, and duality
title.zh: 约束优化、拉格朗日乘子与对偶性

lead.en: Derive box and simplex projections, solve constrained quadratics, prove weak duality and convex KKT sufficiency, and separate qualification, zero gap, attainment and finite penalties.
lead.zh: 推导盒与单纯形投影，解约束二次问题，证明弱对偶及凸KKT充分性，区分约束资格、零间隙、取得最优与有限罚函数。

prerequisites.en: Module 19: convex supporting inequalities, smooth descent and objective certificates; Module 18's column gradients and constraint Jacobians are used throughout.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 19：凸支持不等式、光滑下降及目标证书；全课使用模块 18 的列梯度与约束Jacobian。

en: Specify feasible domains, active restrictions and variational projection certificates.
Derive equality multipliers and diagnose singular constraint descriptions.
Write all KKT conditions and distinguish qualified necessity from convex sufficiency.
Derive dual infima and prove weak duality with the correct signs.
State a qualified Slater theorem and separate zero gap, attainment and sensitivity.
Implement exact simplex projected descent and diagnose residual, penalty and bound faults.
zh: 明确可行域、活跃限制及投影变分证书。
推导等式乘子、诊断奇异约束表示。
写全KKT，区分带资格必要性与凸充分性。
推导对偶下确界、按正确符号证明弱对偶。
写带假设Slater定理，区分零间隙、取得与敏感性。
实现精确单纯形投影下降，诊断残差、罚函数与界的错误。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive nearest-point and line certificates.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推导最近点与直线证书。
检索可行性与乘子符号。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and use the four KKT lines.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，使用四行KKT。

text.en: Compare box, simplex and invalid normalisation shortcuts.
text.zh: 比较盒、单纯形与不正确归一化捷径。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore active sets.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索活跃集。

text.en: Run feasible projected descent and its boundary residual.
text.zh: 运行可行投影下降及边界残差。

text.en: Diagnose infeasible, negative-price and nonconvex certificates.
text.zh: 诊断不可行、负价格及非凸证书。

text.en: Complete choices and the written simplex certificate.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面单纯形证书。

text.en: Read duality and qualified Slater statements.
text.zh: 阅读对偶与带假设Slater陈述。

text.en: Complete the exit task and state each theorem's scope.
text.zh: 完成结业，写各定理范围。
